comments.content: The arguments to `in_array()` are in the wrong order. The function signature is `in_array($needle, $haystack, $strict)`. Here `$fruits` (the array) is passed as the needle and `$fruit` (the string) as the haystack, so the check will always return `false` and every fruit will be reported as out of stock. Swap the arguments so the string `$fruit` is the needle and the array `$fruits` is the haystack.
